name: DR Congo (east)
value: FRN took Bulambika 8 Nov; army counter-attacks
summary: FRN fighters took Bulambika and Bunyakiri in South Kivu on 8 Nov; the army began a counteroffensive; no major city fell
state: The FRN, the Kabila-led successor to AFC-M23, pushed through Kahuzi-Biega park towards Kalehe from 6 Nov, taking Cifunzi on 7 Nov and Bulambika and Bunyakiri on 8 Nov; the army announced a counteroffensive on 9 Nov (Critical Threats, 11 Nov). Local reports said the fall of Bulambika raised fears of a push towards Hombo (Actualite.cd, 9 Nov). The FRN said on 4 Nov it had no intention of advancing on Uvira (New Times). No capture of Goma, Bukavu or Uvira and no direct interstate fighting was found as of 15 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: No direct risk to UK residents. The FCDO advises against travel to eastern DR Congo; anyone with links to the region can follow FCDO travel advice.
rubric_hit: Watch: active fighting (FRN offensive in Kalehe, 6–10 Nov); no major city captured, no direct interstate fighting
